subject: Pipeline sanity: confirm amounts, SKUs, next steps & probabilities
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline sanity: confirm amounts, SKUs, next steps & probabilities

Quick reminder — finance asked us to certify a handful of Q4 opportunities for the upcoming commit review. Please take 1–2 actions below in HubSpot by EOD PST today and reply on this thread if anything blocks you.

Checklist (minimal fields we need accurate for forecasting):
- Amount: confirm ACV (USD) and currency on the opportunity
- Product / SKU: map to the SKU code in the attached SKU sheet (acme-sku-sheet.csv)
- Next step: short text (e.g., "Legal review scheduled", "PO expected") + planned date
- Probability: set to % reflecting current state (be conservative; sales leadership will adjust once validated)
- Close date: confirm month and whether it's commitable this quarter

Attachment: pipeline-sanity-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Related: HS-OPP-2147 (Acme - Account Expansion)

Why this matters: Finance will include validated rows in the commit package. Inaccurate SKUs or inflated probabilities delay recognition and skew our forecast.

Thanks — please ping me if you need help mapping SKUs or pulling docs.

—
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Monica — I started the list and attached the mapping I used for Acme (acme-sku-sheet.csv). Two items I flagged:
- Line item A (OPP-2147 line 2): customer listed "Advanced Gen" as product but there is no SKU in our catalog. I guessed the closest match (SKU-ADV-GEN-v2) but need confirmation.
- Discount: the opportunity includes a one-time onboarding discount that should be split out of ACV; want to confirm Finance treatment.

Attachment: acme-sku-sheet.csv (CSV mapping)

If Laura or Ben can confirm SKU mapping + whether onboarding credit reduces ACV or is recognized separately, I will update HubSpot and set probability to 60% for now.

Thanks Monica — quick replies from Acme side:
- "Advanced Gen" is the same as "Advanced Generation" SKU; our procurement team uses SKU AG-STD-2026 in their PO. Happy to share a copy.
- Onboarding credit: we expect it to be invoiced as a separate line item (not part of recurring ACV).

If you want, procurement can upload the PO draft to the DocuSign link you provide. Our next step is legal review; target date for PO submission is 2026-12-20.

Jorge Ramos

Confirmed on our side:
- SKU mapping: set Acme "Advanced Gen" -> SKU AG-STD-2026 (per Jorge). I'll update the SKU field in HubSpot.

- Probability: set to 60% today (sales judgement + procurement timeline).
- Next step: "Legal review scheduled" — target 2026-12-15 (Ben, please confirm if you need us to create the NDA/contract draft).
